title: Shaytan's Causes You to Forget Your Lord - Remember me
body:
(Mawlana Shaykh stands.) Laa ilaaha illa-Llah, laa ilaaha illa-Llah, laa ilaaha illa-Llah, Muhammadan
Rasoolullah. Muhammadan Habeebullah. Muhammad nooru `arshillah.
(Mawlana Shaykh sits.)
Dastoor yaa Sayyidee, yaa Sultanu 'l-Awliya. We are asking support from heavenly power stations; it may be
less than an atom, because if that support is coming it is like a molecule that may take away everything from
Earth, such is the power from heavenly stations! We are humbly asking for a heavenly support even less than
an atom.
And we are saying now As-salaamu `alaykum, our attenders, and welcome to you, welcome to you, welcome
to you! This is a heavenly good tiding for whoever is going to be an attender for a humble assembly that is
coming. It is a very short, but sharp, address to all people. And we are asking forgiveness and saying,
Astaghfirullah. And we are saying, a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani ‘r-rajeem. You must remember to say,
a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani ‘r-rajeem. If you are doing something without saying, a`oodhu billahi min
ash-Shaytani ‘r-rajeem, Shaytan is breaking what you are asking to do. You may build it and Shaytan is
coming and destroying it. Shayyun thaabit! Something that you are asking to be fixed (firm), you must say,

a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani ‘r-rajeem. That is the base which is reaching to Earth. If not, they are
saying, it is like such a building without a foundation, which is quickly going to be destroyed.
If you are asking to do something for your Lord's pleasure, you must say, a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani ‘rrajeem, "O my Lord, I am asking to bring to you something." For example, if you are cooking a meal and
asking to take it to a person, and around you (are people who are) rushing on you, trying to dust or dirtiness
in it, or to throw poison in it (from evil intentions), ask to be in your Lord's Heavenly Presence. Shaytan is
ordering to his children, "Throw in it something not to go up with cleanliness," but when you say, a`oodhu
billahi min ash-Shaytani ‘r-rajeem, then angels are preventing that badness and making them go away, and
your pleasure is going to reach to heavenly stations. Then, what you are asking to be granted in the Heavenly
Presence of the Lord of Heavens is clean. Therefore, if you are asking for a clean life, say, a`oodhu billahi min
ash-Shaytani ‘r-rajeem.
O our Salafi `ulamas! Marhaban! You are saying such a thing? Is it not from Shari`ah or I am speaking out of
Shari`atullah, what do you think? Yes, that is a very important point, because our worship of every kind is
going to get up to the heavenly Presence of the Lord of Heavens. You must teach people to say, a`oodhu
billahi min ash-Shaytani ‘r-rajeem. But Shaytan,
•••••••••• ••••••••••••
fa ansaahu 'sh-Shaaytan, “Shaytan made him forget.” (12:42)
This ayatu 'l-kareemah, what do you think of it, Salafi `ulamas? fa ansaahu 'sh-Shaaytan. That means this is
an ocean to be awakened. fa ansaahu 'sh-Shaaytan. Two words, but it is such an ocean. Beware! Don't be
heedless, because Shaytan may cheat you and be make you to forget. fa ansaahu 'sh-Shaaytan. From whom?
Every night Salafi `ulamas are taking their shares from naseeha, advising. Now we are making this
declaration from east to west for all `ulamas. fa ansaahu 'sh-Shaaytan. What is Shaytan making people to
forget, that is an very important point, like an ocean! Fa ansaahu. Who is coming? What is that? Now we
understand, Shaytan is coming to all Mankind trying to make believers forget.
What is that forgotten matter? First of all, Shaytan is trying to make people not remember that Allah
Almighty is with them and looking at them, controlling them and ordering to be written about that person his
position. First thing that Shaytan is trying to make people forget is to their Lord, their Creator so that they

are thinking, "We are free ones and no one is controlling us." Never remembering their Creator! If
remembering, what is it going to be? If remembering that Allah Almighty is with him and that Allah Almighty
is going to give His judgment for him, for every effort, every acting, every doing, then that one is forgetting.
Then Shaytan just taking reins and putting reins on that person, riding like this, like that, then all people
giving their reins to hands of Shaytan. Even imitated, highest-level people are forgetting Allah (swt). Every
level of people are also forgetting and they are coming, down, down, down, to be fa ansaahu ash-Shaytan.
First of all, he makes people not to remember that Allah Almighty is looking at them and knows they are
going to do. And when a person is remembering that Allah (swt) he knows, "My Lord is with me." And he will
be careful not to do something that his Lord is going to be unhappy with.
O Salafi `ulamas and other `ulamas also, you may bring commentary on this. fa ansaahu ash-Shaytan maa
yaatee, “Shaytan made him forget about what is coming.” You must be reminders for the nation of the Seal of
Prophets (s), Ummati Muhammad (s)! (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits.) that Shaytan is making people not
to remember that Allah Almighty is with them.
O People! What do you think, is there another god for you except Allah Almighty? (Mawlana Shaykh stands.)
You are Allah Almighty! You are rabbuna! You are illahoon! (Mawlana Shaykh sits.) Ta`aalallahu `ama
yushrikoon? Allahu akbar! Where are the Salafi `ulamas? Are you reminding people in such a way, or you are
only saying, kufr, shirk,bida`, haraam? Why are you saying kufr, shirk, bida`, haraam on such subjects?
Therefore, you are going to be muttaham, accused that you are following your egos, because your egos never
like to open such a meaning to people!
We are like, fa ansaahu ash-Shaytan maa yaatee, “Shaytan made him forget about what is coming.” Shaytan
may come to those people who are not thinking, they are heedless that Allah Almighty is with them. Then
Shaytan is trying to make people to forget about their mission on Earth. For what we have been sent on this
planet and born, day after day, billions of people? For what are they coming? Say, Salafi `ulamas and other
`ulamas!! Why are you not saying? For what are billions of people coming from Unseen Worlds to this
planet? For what? Why you are not opening those meanings? That is Holy Qur'an. You must say! You must
say! For what coming children of Adam (a)? For what have they been sent to be on this planet, eighty years,
seventy years? What is their mission? Why are you not guiding them on that meaning? Are you not knowing,
Salafi `ulamas, as well as all `ulamas? For what purpose have we been sent here? What is the divinely

purpose? Say!
I am perhaps one-hundred-years now and I never heard from anyone, from `ulamas or khutabahs, learned
people or scholars, to say what is the mission of people to come from Unseen Worlds to this world. Why you
are not saying? Also, fa ansaahu 'sh-Shaytan. That means Shaytan wants you to forget. Say! "O People!! Daily
people coming from Unseen World to this life. For what is their missions?" Say!! (Mawlana Shaykh stands.)
••••• •••••••• •••••••• •••••••••• •••••• •••••••••••••
famaa khalaqtu 'l-jinna wa 'l-insa illa liya`abudoon, I have created jinn and humans except that they become
My servants. (51:56)
(Mawlana Shaykh sits.) That is our Lord's purpose!
You are `ulamas. I never heard any scholar or preacher to say this! Every Jumu`ah, every Friday you must
remind, because that is a most important point: for people to know for what purpose they have been created
and for what they have been sent here. For kings, shahs, presidents--mostly their titles are only for dunya,
not for ahkirah--they are not knowing. And `alims, scholars must say it, say it again, say it again, say it again,
another ayatul kareemah:
•••••••••• •••••• •••••••••••• •••••••••• ••••••••• •••••••• •••••••
ati` Allah wa at`i ar-Rasula wa uli ‘l-amri minkum. Obey Allah, obey the Prophet, and obey those in authority
among you. (4:59)
To be obedient servants for Allah Almighty, to be an obedient ummah for the Seal of Prophets (s), and to be
good citizens of your government that has power on you to order or to prevent something, you must follow
them!
First is to obey Allah Almighty, so first, Shaytan is trying to get Mankind to forget their Lord. Secondly, trying
to forget the Seal of Prophets (s). Third, to forget, not to take any care for their obediency to their ruling
governments! That (is directed to) sultans first, then coming down, down, down, having no honor, others
having no honor, then even if imitating they can't reach. Fa ansaahu ash Shaytan. Shaytan just making people
not to remember what Allah Almighty is saying, what His beloved, most glorified servant bringing from his

Lord and saying, making them to forget, forget it. That is fa ansaahu ash Shaytan. If a person is going to
forget something, he must fall in endless troubles. In one second he may do something and he will repent for
what he did.
O People!! Particularly `ulamas, wholly including Ahlu’l-Sunnah wa’l-Jama`ah and Salafi `ulamas, you must
try to teach people of such subjects. If you are doing this then you are doing your best, or you will have a great
responsibility. Don't be angry. If anything is wrong, say to jalaalatul maalik, His Excellency, the king, "This is
wrong," or mufti, you may ask them if this is true or wrong. Alhamdulillah, I use my mind for understanding
what is haqq and what is baatil. That is also a grant from heavens; quickly my conscience is showing if a
person is on the true way, or cheating people, or if they are going on shaytanic ways. May Allah (swt) forgives
us.

O People! Ask for forgiveness. O People! Try to find a guide. Without guide, you can't go to hijaaz. How are
you asking to go to Allah without a guide? You must have. Therefore, Sultan al-Bayazid (q) was saying, Man
laa yakunu lahu shaykhun fashaykhuhu 'sh-shaytan , “Who has no guide to the true path has the devil as his
guide.” It means who he is with his Lord, Almighty Allah, is always reminding because he is saying, Allah
Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah....
O Salafi `ulamas! You are saying that is bida`." What is bida`, to say "Allah"? Say, loudly or silently! Say!
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah. Haqq! You can't say
that is bida`; you are wrong ones! Allah Almighty is throwing you away from holy lands! Time is over, now
haqq (truth) must be clear and baatil (falsehood) must also be clear so that people know which way is safety
and which way is dangerous.
Shukr yaa Rabbee, shukr yaa Rabbee, shukr yaa Rabbee.
Fatihah.
Okay? Shukr! Alhamdulillah.
(Mawlana Shaykh speaks to Shaykh Hisham Effendi on the phone.)
